note: Petrol/Diesel/CNG car figures sourced from ARAI-claimed mileage dataset (500-variant Indian market expansion, deduped to unique make/model/fuel combos). Bikes are a separate curated 2025 Indian lineup (petrol/CNG figures are manufacturer/ARAI-claimed). EV bikes are only included where the source listed a battery kWh alongside its km/charge range, so a real kWh/100km efficiency could be derived (kWh/range*100) — EV bikes with only a km/charge range and no stated battery size were left out rather than loading a range figure into a slot the cost calculator treats as consumption efficiency. Source list's E20 ethanol-compatibility flag was dropped since nearly all current-generation FI motorcycles are already E20-compliant and it isn't a distinguishing mileage input. Real-world mileage varies with driving style, load, and traffic — always editable via manual override.
